quranTranslation.text: And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.

explanation.bs: Istina je došla i neistina je nestala – dolazak s vidljivom posljedicom.
explanation.en: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished — an arrival with a visible result.

quranTranslation.text: And every nation hath its term, and when its term cometh, they cannot put it off an hour nor yet advance (it).

explanation.bs: Kad dođe njihov rok, ne može se odgoditi – stvarni, odlučujući dolazak.
explanation.en: When their term comes it cannot be delayed — a real, decisive arrival.

quranTranslation.text: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

explanation.bs: Kad stigne Allahova pomoć i pobjeda – dolazak predstavljen kao stizanje.
explanation.en: When the help of Allah and the victory come — the coming presented as an arrival.

quranTranslation.text: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).

explanation.bs: Allahova odredba stoji u prošlom vremenu (أَتَى, ‚došla je‘), a ipak se kaže „zato je ne požurujte“; tefsir prošlo vrijeme tumači sigurnošću onoga što dolazi. Primjer dolaska koji je tek na putu.
explanation.en: The command of Allah is put in the past tense (أَتَى, ‘has come’), yet they are told “seek not ye to hasten it”; tafsir explains the past tense as the certainty of what is coming. An example of a coming still on its way.

quranTranslation.text: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?

explanation.bs: Vrijeme je prošlo nad čovjekom dok još nije bio spomena vrijedan.
explanation.en: A period of time came upon man when he was not yet a thing worth mentioning.

quranTranslation.text: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?

explanation.bs: Vijest o Musau koja do slušaoca stiže.
explanation.en: The story of Moses, reaching the listener.

quranTranslation.text: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Reci: Allahu, Gospodaru carstva, Ti daješ carstvo kome želiš i oduzimaš carstvo od koga želiš“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Njemu pripada carstvo i Njemu pripada hvala“ – pravo i trajno carstvo.
explanation.en: “Unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise” — the true and lasting dominion.

quranTranslation.text: Or are they jealous of mankind because of that which Allah of His bounty hath bestowed upon them? For We bestowed upon the house of Abraham (of old) the Scripture and wisdom, and We bestowed on them a mighty kingdom.

explanation.bs: „…i dali smo im ogromno carstvo“ – carstvo koje Allah daje ljudima; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “…and We bestowed on them a mighty kingdom” — dominion that Allah gives to people; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! he hath no power over those who believe and put trust in their Lord.

explanation.bs: „On (šejtan) zaista nema vlasti nad vjernicima i nad onima koji se na svoga Gospodara oslanjaju.“
explanation.en: “Lo! he [Satan] hath no power over those who believe and put trust in their Lord.”

quranTranslation.text: And slay not the life which Allah hath forbidden save with right. Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir, but let him not commit excess in slaying. Lo! he will be helped.

explanation.bs: „A ko bude nepravedno ubijen, njegovom nasljedniku smo dali ovlast“ – ovlast kao moć; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir” — authority as power; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Their messengers said: Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calleth you that He may forgive you your sins and reprieve you unto an appointed term. They said: Ye are but mortals like us, who would fain turn us away from what our fathers used to worship. Then bring some clear warrant.

explanation.bs: „Pa donesite nam jasan dokaz!“ – سُلْطَان kao dokaz.
explanation.en: “Then bring some clear warrant” — سُلْطَان as proof.

quranTranslation.text: He giveth wisdom unto whom He will, and he unto whom wisdom is given, he truly hath received abundant good. But none remember except men of understanding.

explanation.bs: „Kome je data mudrost, dato mu je mnogo dobra, a pouku primaju samo razumom obdareni“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He unto whom wisdom is given, he truly hath received abundant good. But none remember except men of understanding” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth and (in) the difference of night and day are tokens (of His Sovereignty) for men of understanding,

explanation.bs: „U tome kako su stvorena nebesa i Zemlja, i u izmjenjivanju noći i dana, zaista ima znakova za razumom obdarene.“
explanation.en: “Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth and (in) the difference of night and day are tokens (of His Sovereignty) for men of understanding.”

quranTranslation.text: Is he who knoweth that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth like him who is blind? But only men of understanding heed;

explanation.bs: „Zar je isti onaj ko zna da je ono što ti je objavljeno od tvoga Gospodara istina, i onaj ko je slijep? Pouku primaju samo razumom obdareni.“
explanation.en: “Is he who knoweth that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth like him who is blind? But only men of understanding heed.”

quranTranslation.text: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.

explanation.bs: „Jedite i pasite stoku svoju! U tome, doista, ima znakova za one što imaju pameti“ – ar-Rāġib navodi njegove završne riječi.
explanation.en: “Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought” — ar-Rāġib cites its closing words.

quranTranslation.text: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought.

explanation.bs: „Zar ih nije poučilo to koliko smo pokoljenja prije njih uništili, po čijim nastambama oni sada hode? U tome, doista, ima znakova za one što imaju pameti.“
explanation.en: “Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought.”

quranTranslation.text: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.

explanation.bs: Zekerijja svom narodu daje znak: „Slavite Ga ujutro i navečer!“
explanation.en: Zechariah signals to his people: “Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.”

quranTranslation.text: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

explanation.bs: „Kad su mu navečer bili pokazani plemeniti, brzi konji“ – večer kao vrijeme događaja, ne samo ibadeta.
explanation.en: “When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers” — the evening as the time of an event, not only of worship.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.

explanation.bs: „Na Dan kad ga vide, bit će im kao da nisu ostali osim jedne večeri ili njenog jutra“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And glorify Him early and late.

explanation.bs: „I slavite Ga izjutra rano i u predvečerje“ – ar-Rāġib navodi riječi ‚bukratan wa aṣīlā‘.
explanation.en: “And glorify Him early and late” — ar-Rāġib cites the words ‘bukratan wa aṣīlā’.

quranTranslation.text: And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the morning and the evening hours.

explanation.bs: „Pred Allahom padaju na sedždu svi na nebesima i na Zemlji, milom ili silom, a i njihove sjene, u jutra i u predvečerja.“
explanation.en: “And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the morning and the evening hours.”

quranTranslation.text: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening.

explanation.bs: Nevjernici o Kur'anu: „… pa mu se diktiraju u rano jutro i u predvečerje“ – isti par i u riječima onih koji poriču.
explanation.en: The disbelievers about the Quran: “… so that they are dictated to him morn and evening” — the same pair, even in the words of those who deny.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „… i On sve zna“ – znanje o svakoj stvari, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And He is knower of all things” — knowledge of every thing, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Then he (Joseph) began the search with their bags before his brother's bag, then he produced it from his brother's bag. Thus did We contrive for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother according to the king's law unless Allah willed. We raise by grades (of mercy) whom We will, and over every lord of knowledge there is one more knowing.

explanation.bs: „… a iznad svakog onog ko ima znanje ima još učeniji“ – ar-Rāġib daje dva čitanja: čovjek učeniji od drugoga, ili Allah, Kojem jedinom uistinu pripada to ime.
explanation.en: “Over every lord of knowledge there is one more knowing” — ar-Rāġib gives two readings: a person more knowing than another, or Allah, to Whom alone the name truly belongs.

quranTranslation.text: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „… a Allah je upućen u ono što radite“ – ar-Rāġib: zna vijesti o vašim djelima, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And Allah is Informed of what ye do” — ar-Rāġib: He knows the reports of your deeds, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.

explanation.bs: „Zar da ne zna Onaj Koji je stvorio, a On je Blagi, Upućeni?“ – uz ‚Blagi‘ (al-Laṭīf): upućen i u ono što je najsitnije i najskrivenije, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.” — beside ‘the Subtle’ (al-Laṭīf): aware even of what is finest and most hidden, as befits Him.
